steps.title: Open the desktop home
steps.narration: The desk displays the latest screen over the registered universe of tradable walls, ranked by entry quality. This view surfaces the kept product surface this iteration.
steps.point_out: The Desk navigation tab is active; the page shows Screen History (153 recorded screens in 2026) and Forward Returns sections below.

steps.title: View the Screen History calendar
steps.narration: The calendar shows every recorded session date in the universe, color-coded by signal family. Dates with screens are marked; click any to navigate through the recorded signals.
steps.point_out: The year selector shows 2026, and the month/day grid displays 153 recorded screens with green highlights marking the registered screens.

steps.title: Scroll down to see Forward Returns section
steps.narration: Below the calendar, the Forward Returns section measures every wall's entry quality by its forward price movement. The desk's own rail conventions ensure comparable metrics across every detected signal.
steps.point_out: The Forward Returns heading appears with the recorded snapshot timestamp and the first measurement row showing wall entry metrics.
